title: My bones
examples: What are the main parts of my skeleton?
How do my bones help me move?

explain.say: Today you will learn about your bones. Bones are hard parts inside your body. They give your body its shape.

draw.text: Bones give body shape and support.

explain.say: Now look. This is a human skeleton in 3D. Can you see the skull and the ribcage? Tap any part to hear about it.
Your skull is the bone around your head. It protects your brain.
Your ribs are curved bones in your chest. They protect your heart and lungs.
Your bones help you stand up tall. Your leg bones help you walk and run.
Your bones are a strong frame for your whole body.

draw.text: Bones are your body's strong frame.

explain.say: Muscles pull on your bones to make you move. Bones and muscles work together.

faq.q: What is the main job of my bones?
faq.a: The main job is to give your body its shape and provide a strong support frame for everything else.
asks: Why do I have a skeleton?

faq.q: Do my bones protect my organs?
faq.a: Yes, the skull protects your brain, and your ribs protect your heart and lungs.
asks: Is my brain safe inside my body?

faq.q: Are my bones hard all the time?
faq.a: Your bones are hard, but they are alive and they grow as you grow. Everyday foods like milk, yoghurt and green vegetables help them grow strong.
asks: How do I keep my bones healthy?

faq.q: Do I need muscles to move my bones?
faq.a: Yes. Your muscles are joined to your bones. They pull on your bones to make you move.

faq.q: What is the difference between my skull and my ribs?
faq.a: The skull protects your head and brain, while the ribs protect the soft parts in your chest area.
asks: Which bone is around my chest?
What bones are near my head?

facts: The skeleton is made up of many different bones working together.
The skull is a hard case that keeps your brain safe.
Your ribs form a cage around your chest organs.
Bones help give your body its overall shape.

quiz.why: Your skull is a hard case around your brain.

wrong.1: Your ribs protect your heart and lungs.
wrong.2: Your spine is your backbone, and it holds you up.

quiz.why: Your ribs curve around your chest, where your heart and lungs are.

wrong.2: Your knees are joints in your legs, far from your ribs.

quiz.say: What do you call all your bones together?
quiz.why: All your bones together make your skeleton.

wrong.0: Skin covers the outside of your body.
wrong.1: Muscles pull on bones to move them.
